description: Starts an upgrade eligibility check for a flight, cruise, or rail booking. Returns a secure page (and, where supported, an inline form) for the traveler to enter their booking reference and last name.

carrier.description: Airline/cruise/rail name or IATA code if known (e.g. 'Air Canada' or 'AC').

intentContext.description: The traveler's stated shopping intent — bound to the session and surfaced back so offers are presented against it.

budgetAmount.description: Traveler's stated budget for the upgrade.

budgetCurrency.description: ISO currency for the budget, e.g. 'CAD'.

notes.description: Short preference note, e.g. 'anniversary trip, wants lie-flat'. For privacy, leave out booking references and names.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language for the page/offer (e.g. 'fr', 'es'). Defaults to 'en'.

travelerQuestion.description: The traveler's request in their own words, verbatim (e.g. 'can I upgrade my Swiss flight to business?'). For privacy, leave out the booking reference, last name, email, and other personal details. Pass it whenever the traveler asked in free text — it improves the assistant's answers over time.

name: start_eligibility_check
title: Start Eligibility Check
